notes.note: Type, and a hand writes it out
Backspace on ink: it’s crossed out
Change a word: the new one goes above
A notes app, written by hand
Cross it out, then hold Backspace: scribbled out
Lists and checklists, in the writer’s own way
Click a box: the pen ticks it
Pick another writer: your words, in their hand
